description: Howdy Morning is a practical daily food and wellness journal. Log meals, scan barcodes, understand your energy, and build healthier routines with simple, privacy-first tools.
shortDescription: A calmer daily loop for food, energy, and healthier habits.

testFlight.subtitle: Track your food, energy, and daily habits.
testFlight.betaDescription: Thanks for testing Howdy Morning. Please log meals, try barcode scanning, connect supported health data if available, and report anything confusing or broken.
testFlight.reviewNotes: Test build for TestFlight distribution. Use a test account; do not enter sensitive health information you do not want included in the test environment.

firebaseAppDistribution.releaseNotes: Test the daily journal, meal logging, barcode scanning, health integrations, and links from howdymornin.io. Please report crashes, unexpected navigation, or unclear copy.
firebaseAppDistribution.testerInstructions: Install the build, sign in with a test account, complete a food entry, try barcode scanning, and open a https://howdymornin.io link on a device with the app installed.

screenshots.notes: Replace the placeholder files with device captures before store submission.
